sources.snippet: LFM2.5-2.6B is an on-device agentic model that plans, calls tools, and runs multi-step tasks at 220 tok/s in under 2.5 GB. Open weights on Hugging Face.

sources.title: LFM2.5-2.6B - docs.liquid.ai
sources.snippet: ← Back to Text Models LFM2.5-2.6B is Liquid AI's 2.6B dense model built for agentic workloads with a 131K context window and native tool calling. It is a reasoning model that always thinks before it answers. It runs on edge devices and it is trained to work reliably inside agent harnesses like Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Pi.
